claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, capsaicin is unlikely to kill most cancer cell lines; any selective killing would reflect TRPV1-independent, non-specific effects such as oxidative stress or membrane perturbation rather than a dominant cytotoxic mechanism.
